facts.fact: TechnoMag states POTRAZ is the designated Data Protection Authority under section 5 of the Act and issued a notice to unlicensed organisations; dated by publication.
TechnoMag states the Act establishes the data protection framework and that licensing under it is mandatory and enforced by notice; dated by publication.
TechnoMag states SI 155 of 2024 was promulgated in September 2024 and required a Data Controller Licence by 12 March 2025.
facts.system: Cyber and Data Protection (Licensing of Data Controllers and Appointment of Data Protection Officers) Regulations, 2024 (SI 155 of 2024)

facts.fact: TechnoMag reports POTRAZ issued a notice warning unlicensed organisations processing personal data to comply immediately, noting widespread non-compliance after the 12 March 2025 deadline; no sanction is reported. Dated by publication.
